title: Non Attendance at Scheduled Appointments as a Marker of Mortality and Hospital Admission
brief_summary: To evaluate the association of non attendance at scheduled appointments with visits in the emergency department, hospitalizations and mortality during one year follow up.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Over 17 years.
* Adults who attended, did not attend a scheduled appointment at the Outpatient care system at the Italian Hospital of Buenos Aires (HIBA)

Exclusion Criteria:

\- The refusal to register or to the informed consent process.
study_population: We included all requested appointments (random consecutive sampling) between 2012 and 2013 (24 month).
